entries.title: Romans 12:1
segments: ¶I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] your reasonable service.

entries.title: Romans 12:2
segments: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what [is] that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

entries.title: Romans 12:3
segments: For I say, through the grace given to me, to everyone who is among you, not to think [of himself] more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly, as God has dealt to each one a measure of faith.

entries.title: Romans 12:4
segments: For as we have many members in one body, but all the members do not have the same function,

entries.title: Romans 12:5
segments: so we, [being] many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.

entries.title: Romans 12:6
segments: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, [let us use them]: if prophecy, [let us prophesy] in proportion to our faith;

entries.title: Romans 12:7
segments: or ministry, [let us use it] in [our] ministering; he who teaches, in teaching;

entries.title: Romans 12:8
segments: he who exhorts, in exhortation; he who gives, with liberality; he who leads, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

entries.title: Romans 12:9
segments: [Let] love [be] without hypocrisy. Abhor what is evil. Cling to what is good.

entries.title: Romans 12:10
segments: [Be] kindly affectionate to one another with brotherly love, in honor giving preference to one another;

entries.title: Romans 12:11
segments: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

entries.title: Romans 12:12
segments: rejoicing in hope, patient in tribulation, continuing steadfastly in prayer;

entries.title: Romans 12:13
segments: distributing to the needs of the saints, given to hospitality.

entries.title: Romans 12:14
segments: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.

entries.title: Romans 12:15
segments: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.

entries.title: Romans 12:16
segments: Be of the same mind toward one another. Do not set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Do not be wise in your own opinion.

entries.title: Romans 12:17
segments: Repay no one evil for evil. Have regard for good things in the sight of all men.

entries.title: Romans 12:18
segments: If it is possible, as much as depends on you, live peaceably with all men.

entries.title: Romans 12:19
segments: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but [rather] give place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance [is] Mine, I will repay," says the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 12:20
segments: Therefore "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; If he is thirsty, give him a drink; For in so doing you will heap coals of fire on his head."

entries.title: Romans 12:21
segments: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
